notes.content:
Dear fellow adventurers,

We are excited to share exciting news with you! In this update as part of the Major Update V2, we have added some appearance and new atmosphere that will make you comfy in the world of Fractals of Destiny to become more colorful.

Here’s what’s new in this update:
[list]
[*] Zerva’s profile picture is now available in the Alliance Gadget – Profile Tab
[*] You can now apply hair, eye, and eyebrow dyes to both Ancient Suits and United Suits
[*] Eyeshadow is now applied to Ancient Suits and Dragonyx Suits

notes.title: Major Update V2 (1st Anniversary) is Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367520/94809e45c11c30125e199e2edc734caf07ea4e6e.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

After a year since the release, we have received a lot of feedback, support, and suggestions from amazing players. Through messages we’ve read from the community, direct emails, and messages to our team, we are truly grateful to have kind-hearted players who continue to help us make the game better. We are dedicated to improving the game and making it the best experience possible for Fractals of Destiny players. 

[b]New Visual Enchancement[/b]
Shaders : Toon (BETA)
The Toon (BETA) shader brings an anime-realistic visual style to life with a dramatic and artistic presentation. It features stylized lighting, enhanced outlines on all characters, objects, and environments, and refined shading that will give you a comfortable feel, especially for those who enjoy fantasy-genre. This shader creating a unique visual identity that blends realism with anime-inspired expression. Although still in BETA, it supports most environmental effects and works with the game's dynamic lighting system. 

Message: Using this shader will add more performance cost to your hardware.

[b]System Update[/b]
Progression Save System from Green Pedra Crystal to Profile System. Your progression will be autosaved after certain events or moving to other area/maps.

[b]Upgraded Features[/b]
Applied In-Game Settings (Main Menu and Alliance Gadget)
We’ve upgraded the settings system to allow players to adjust options such as video, audio, and keybindings directly from both the main menu and during gameplay via the Alliance Gadget. This ensures a more seamless and flexible experience without needing to return to the main menu.

[b]Added more settings[/b]
[list]
[*] Shaders Switching (Default and Toon BETA)
[*] Sensitivity and Look Inversion
[*] Camera Bounce/Shake
[*] Motion Blur (More detailed options)
[*] Keybindings (You are now able to change prefered keys on keyboard/mouse and gamepad)
[/list]
[b]Game Balancing and Adjustment[/b]
[list]
[*] Upgraded Dymloz difficulty on Phase 1
[/list]
[b]Game Optimization[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized VFX of Zerva's skill
[*] Optimized several levels
[/list]
[b]Bug and Glitch Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed missing localization words
[*] Fixed image UI issues
[*] Fixed crash issues
[/list]
[b]Important News[/b]
We sincerely apologize to Fractals of Destiny players. Due to a potential crash issue on some devices caused by the previous save system (Green Pedra Crystal), and after much consideration, we have decided to completely redesign the saving system. It is now an autosave system, which automatically saves your progress to your profile after certain events or when moving between maps/areas.
We hope players can read this issue. Once again, we apologize for this unexpected incident.

Your feedback, support, and suggestions are truly precious to us. We are dedicated to creating the best possible gaming experience on playing Fractals of Destiny, it might even give you ASMR while playing our game.

If you haven’t joined us yet, we want to invite you to dive into the beautiful world of Fractals of Destiny.
If you unexpectedly found any bugs, issues, or anything that feels off, please reach us to Discord, our community channels or if you doesn't feel uncomfortable in media, you can direct messages to our humble developers team. We’re always happy to listen — your feedback and suggestion helps us improve the game and getting better.
Together, let’s make Fractals of Destiny better.

Once again, thank you for being part of our journey!

Best regards,
Krakatoa Studios Team

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE V1.1.1
notes.content:
We want to share some exciting news for Fractals of Destiny players! Our game has been updated from version V.1.0.9 to V.1.1.1, bringing a number of major updates that will definitely improve your gaming experience. This update includes all major updates with various new features, improved performance, and much better visuals. Here are some of the highlights of this latest update:

[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Endgame Gear and Weapon (Destiny Armor Sets & Dragonyx Armor Sets) (Blades of Fractals & Bloody Dragon Blades)
[*] Added Advanced Gear & Crafting System (we provide a better and easier-to-understand experience)
[*] Added Advanced Extraction System (Now there is an interaction system within the world that supports character development)
[*] Added Advanced Bomb System & debuff
[/list]

[b]Added More Settings[/b]
[list]
[*] Anti-Aliasing (TAA/FXAA/SMAA)
[*] Motion Blur (this feature can be turned on or off)
[*] Volume Settings (Master, Voice, Effects, and Music)
[/list]

[b]Updated Visuals[/b]
[list]
[*] Advanced Lighting on Characters and Environments
[*] Advanced Arsenal Visualization
[*] Upgraded some levels
[*] Upgraded some monsters
[*] Updated NPC appearances: Alice, Jean, Aghmar and Dr. Han
[*] Status Disorders on enemies
[*] Status buffs on players
[*] Upgraded Combat Visualization
[*] Upgraded Gear Visualization: Ancient Armor Sets, United Armor Sets
[*] Upgraded some Combo & Skill Visualizations
[*] Upgraded Drop System Visualization
[/list]

[b]Advanced UI Visualization[/b]
[list]
[*] Title Screen UI Enhancement
[*] Settings UI Enhancement
[*] Save & Load UI Enhancement
[*] Arsenal UI Enhancement
[*] Extraction UI Enhancement
[*] Dialogue & Skit UI Enhancement
[*] Charm UI Enhancement
[*] Changed some level names
[/list]

[b]Game Optimization[/b]
[list]
[*] Character Optimization
[*] Enemy Optimization
[*] Level Optimization
[/list]

[b]Bug and Glitch Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed missing localization words
[*] Fixed image UI issues
[*] Fixed achievement submission and contract bugs
[*] Fixed bug submission for Alice
[/list]

A big thank you to all Fractals of Destiny players. Your support and input have been a source of encouragement for us. As fellow fans and gamers, we are committed to providing the best experience and ensuring your comfort when playing our games.

We really need your support more than ever by giving a positive rating and comment. It means a lot to us and helps us continue to grow.

For those who haven't tried it, we invite you to experience the excitement of this game yourself. We've worked hard to create an unforgettable experience, and we hope you love it.

Have fun and enjoy the exciting adventure in Fractals of Destiny!

notes.title: UPDATE V1.0.9
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Sorry for the inconvenience, we have updating the game with some new adjustment as well as upgrading the game version to V1.0.9. The following updates are : 

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Adding AI Camera Reset
[*] While in action, the action camera is now following the enemy/target position and fix the rotation. It will happened whenever the camera isn't moved or if the camera movement is too extreme. The camera action also not happened if player don't hit any enemy or target.
[*] Free Action Mode is now based by character direction, while Lock Action Mode is based by camera direction.
[*] Enhancement Combat System
[/list]
[olist]
[*] We have increased the 'grip' of attack between the controller and targetted enemy, also increasing the responsivity on attack, evade, and hit reactions.
[*] We have updated some immunity system to some monster.
[*] Adding Parry Chance while player executing combos, it will decrease incoming damage while keep the combos still performing.
[/olist]

[b]Optimization[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated Game Size (37.7 GB to 35.8 GB).
[*] Optimization in several maps.
[/list]

[*] Some Zerva bug attacks.
[/list]
